Stats

SCL_Oliver_Mom
Mummy is a unique Wraith in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. It is bound in service to the cursed child  Oliver.

Involvement

'Mummy' appears during the second game of hide-and-seek with Oliver, requiring the party to  Hide if they wish to avoid a fight. It also enters them into Turn-Based Mode. The party must then either sneak their way into the ruined house where Oliver reappears in two turns or attempt to fight the powerful shadow which is backed up by  'Daddy' and  'Doggy'.

The wraith re-appears during the final confrontation with  Oliver at the heart of Reithwin Town, even if defeated earlier.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
